s2.ptxt: Remove the union bolt and gasket, and disconnect front brake flexible hose No.1 from the front disc brake cylinder assembly LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Disc Brake Cylinder Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Hold the slide pin with a wrench, remove the 2 bolts and remove the front disc brake cylinder assembly LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Disc Brake Pad Kit Front

s2.ptxt: Remove the front disc brake pads from the front disc brake cylinder mounting LH.
Remove front disc brake anti-squeal shim No.1 and front disc brake anti-squeal shim No.2 from the front disc brake pads.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Disc Brake Pad Support Plate No.1

s2.ptxt: Remove front disc brake pad support plate No.1 from the front disc brake cylinder mounting LH.

atten3.ptxt: Front disc brake pad support plate No.1 and front disc brake pad support plate No.2 have different shapes, so put identification marks on them to identify their positions when installing.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Disc Brake Pad Support Plate No.2

s2.ptxt: Remove front disc brake pad support plate No.2 from the front disc brake cylinder mounting LH.

atten3.ptxt: Front disc brake pad support plate No.1 and front disc brake pad support plate No.2 have different shapes, so put identification marks on them to identify their positions when installing.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Disc Brake Cylinder Slide Pin

s2.ptxt: Remove the front disc brake cylinder slide pins from the front disc brake cylinder mounting LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Disc Brake Cylinder Slide Bush NO.1

s2.ptxt: Using a flat-head screwdriver with its tip wrapped with protective tape, remove front disc brake cylinder slide bushing No.1 from front disc brake cylinder slide pin No.2.

atten3.ptxt: Do not damage front disc brake cylinder slide pin No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Disc Brake Bush Dust Boot

s2.ptxt: Remove the front disc brake bushing dust boots from the front disc brake cylinder mounting LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Disc Brake Cylinder Mounting LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and front disc brake cylinder mounting LH.
Put matchmarks on the disc and axle hub, and remove the disc.
